Feature id 5188237101891584 appears in the milestone=152 listing under 'Enabled by default' (verified 2026-07-28); folder v152/reference-target-for-cross-root-aria/ matches slug and milestone exactly; 'Shipped in Chrome 152' is anchored to the authoritative listing, and the chromestatus identity link is on both pages.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible technical reference documentation page for a Web Components accessibility feature: tables of attributes, IDL code blocks, cross-linked child pages
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use one h1 with sequential heading levels; give data tables a caption and scope=row/col headers; keep code in semantic pre/code; provide a text alternative pattern (role=note + aria-label) for status banners; avoid fake headings built from bold paragraphs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single h1 per page, ordered h2s, caption+scoped tables (supported-attributes, compat), role=note baseline banner with aria-label, pre/code throughout, strong-label warn-block pattern.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference page with wide monospace tables and very long unbreakable strings (URLs, msgid links) at 390px mobile viewport: preventing horizontal overflow and column crush
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer natural flow over fixed widths; wrap wide tables in a horizontally scrolling container with an explicit min-width so columns never crush; allow unbreakable strings to wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere; verify layout stability at small widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap with overflow-x:auto and min-width 34rem on doc tables, overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/table cells; screenshots on PORT=3188 pending as the final verification step.
